title: move (SDK to viewer)
description: One half-move of the game, in order and without gaps.

ply.description: Number of this half-move since start_fen, starting at 1.

fen.description: Position after the move. The viewer adopts it if its own board disagrees.

by.description: Whether the bot or its opponent played the move.

white_ms.description: White's remaining time after the move, as far as the SDK knows it.

elapsed_ms.description: Thinking time of the bot for its own move, measured by the SDK.

info.description: Search information the bot sent with its move.
